proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ s₁ s₂ T₁ T₂ hT h1 h2 hs
  set u := T₁ -ᵥ s₁.center with hu
  set v := T₂ -ᵥ s₂.center with hv
  set w := T₂ -ᵥ T₁ with hw
  have hw0 : w ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr hT.symm
  have hw2 : ‖w‖ ^ 2 ≠ 0 := pow_ne_zero 2 (norm_ne_zero_iff.mpr hw0)
  have iu : inner ℝ w u = 0 := h1.inner_left_eq_zero_of_mem (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ T₁ T₂)
  have iv : inner ℝ w v = 0 := by
    have := h2.inner_left_eq_zero_of_mem (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ T₁ T₂)
    rw [← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev, inner_neg_left, neg_eq_zero] at this
    exact this
  have nu : ‖u‖ = s₁.radius := by rw [hu, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub V]; exact h1.mem_sphere
  have nv : ‖v‖ = s₂.radius := by rw [hv, ← dist_eq_norm_vsub V]; exact h2.mem_sphere
  obtain ⟨⟨p₁, hp₁, p₂, hp₂, hr⟩, hn1, hn2⟩ := hs
  have hdir : ∀ {p q : P}, p ∈ line[ℝ, T₁, T₂] → q ∈ line[ℝ, T₁, T₂] → ∃ a : ℝ, a • w = p -ᵥ q := by
    intro p q hp hq
    have := AffineSubspace.vsub_mem_direction hp hq
    rw [direction_affineSpan, mem_vectorSpan_pair_rev] at this
    exact this
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := hdir (left_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ T₁ T₂) hp₁
  obtain ⟨b, hb⟩ := hdir (right_mem_affineSpan_pair ℝ T₁ T₂) hp₂
  have hx : s₁.center -ᵥ p₁ ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hn1 (h ▸ hp₁))
  have hy : p₂ -ᵥ s₂.center ≠ 0 := vsub_ne_zero.mpr (fun h => hn2 (h ▸ hp₂))
  obtain ⟨α, β, hα, hβ, heq⟩ := hr.exists_pos hx hy
  have xe : s₁.center -ᵥ p₁ = a • w - u := by rw [ha, hu, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_left]
  have ye : p₂ -ᵥ s₂.center = v - b • w := by rw [hb, hv, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_left]
  rw [xe, ye] at heq
  have hab : α * a = -(β * b) := by
    have h3 := congrArg (inner ℝ w) heq
    simp only [inner_smul_right, inner_sub_right, iu, iv, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq] at h3
    have : (α * a + β * b) * ‖w‖ ^ 2 = 0 := by linear_combination h3
    have := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_right hw2
    linarith
  have huv : -(α • u) = β • v := by
    have : -(α • u) - β • v = -(α * a + β * b) • w := by
      linear_combination (norm := module) heq
    rw [hab, neg_add_cancel, neg_zero, zero_smul] at this
    exact sub_eq_zero.mp this
  have hnorm : α * s₁.radius = β * s₂.radius := by
    have := congrArg norm huv
    rwa [norm_neg, norm_smul, norm_smul, Real.norm_eq_abs, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hα, abs_of_pos hβ, nu, nv] at this
  have hin : -(α * inner ℝ u v) = β * s₂.radius ^ 2 := by
    have := congrArg (fun z => inner ℝ z v) huv
    simp only [inner_neg_left, inner_smul_left, real_inner_self_eq_norm_sq, nv] at this
    simpa using this
  have huv' : inner ℝ u v = -(s₁.radius * s₂.radius) := by
    have : α * (inner ℝ u v + s₁.radius * s₂.radius) = 0 := by linear_combination -hin + s₂.radius * hnorm
    have := (mul_eq_zero.mp this).resolve_left hα.ne'
    linarith
  have hc : s₂.center -ᵥ s₁.center = u + w - v := by
    rw [hu, hv, hw, add_comm, vsub_add_vsub_cancel, vsub_sub_vsub_cancel_left]
  rw [dist_comm s₁.center, dist_eq_norm_vsub V s₂.center, dist_eq_norm_vsub V T₁ T₂, ← neg_vsub_eq_vsub_rev T₂ T₁, norm_neg, hc, norm_sub_sq_real, norm_add_sq_real, inner_add_left, real_inner_comm w u, iu, iv, huv', nu, nv]
  ring
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (s₁ s₂ : EuclideanGeometry.Sphere P) (T₁ T₂ : P), T₁ ≠ T₂ → s₁.IsTangentAt T₁ line[ℝ, T₁, T₂] → s₂.IsTangentAt T₂ line[ℝ, T₁, T₂] → (line[ℝ, T₁, T₂]).SOppSide s₁.center s₂.center → dist T₁ T₂ ^ 2 = dist s₁.center s₂.center ^ 2 - (s₁.radius + s₂.radius) ^ 2
